rules.coordinates: event article coordinates if within 30 km of the affected locality, otherwise the affected locality's Wikipedia coordinates
rules.affected_population: sum of curated components, each verified to occur in the source text next to a keyword of its class (see affected_population_evidence)
rules.severity: 0.95 if deaths>=1000 or affected>=1e6; 0.85 if deaths>=100 or affected>=1e5; 0.75 if deaths>=20 or affected>=1e4; 0.65 if deaths>=1 or affected>=1e3; else 0.55
rules.priority: CRITICAL if severity>=0.9; HIGH >=0.8; MODERATE >=0.7; else LOW
rules.estimated_duration_hours: 24 casualty incidents; 72 earthquake/tsunami/landslide/dam failure/flash flood; 120 flood/cyclone/dust storm
rules.patient_present: true for sudden-onset casualty-producing types, false for floods/cyclones/dust storms
